newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares drift down, Hermis well-traded.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares drift down, Hermis well-traded.

text.p: Lithuanian shares drifted lower in quiet trade on Thursday, with second largest bank Hermis Bank the most active stock on the market, dealers said.
The group A index of shares, which tracks the most active stocks on the central market, fell by 37.19 points to 1,401.93 amid overall volume of 1.26 million litas.
"Prices are comparatively high and investors seem a bit reluctant to buy at the moment," one broker said.
Hermis was the most active, falling to 1.45 litas from Tuesday's high of 1.46 litas and trading 522,580 litas. Bloc trades were 75,000 litas and there were no T-bill transactions.
